command:
set -eu
root=/srv/legacy2/incremental-archive-chain
if [ -e "$root/recovered" ]; then
  printf 'RECOVERED_EXISTS\n'
  find "$root/recovered" -maxdepth 3 -printf '%M %u:%g %s %P\n' | sort
else
  printf 'RECOVERED_ABSENT\n'
fi
printf 'MEDIA_HASHES_BEFORE\n'
sha256sum "$root/base.tar" "$root/day2.tar" "$root/day3.tar" "$root/chain.txt"

set -eu
root=/srv/legacy2/incremental-archive-chain
if [ -e "$root/recovered" ]; then
  printf 'RECOVERED_EXISTS\n'
  find "$root/recovered" -maxdepth 3 -printf '%M %u:%g %s %P\n' | sort
else
  printf 'RECOVERED_ABSENT\n'
fi
printf 'MEDIA_HASHES_BEFORE\n'
sha256sum "$root/base.tar" "$root/day2.tar" "$root/day3.tar" "$root/chain.txt"

set -eu
root=/srv/legacy2/incremental-archive-chain
stage=$(mktemp -d /tmp/legacy2-recovery.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf "$stage"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
mkdir "$root/recovered"
while IFS= read -r archive; do
  [ -n "$archive" ] || continue
  case "$archive" in
    /*|*..*) printf 'unsafe archive path: %s\n' "$archive" >&2; exit 1 ;;
  esac
  [ -f "$root/$archive" ] || { printf 'missing archive: %s\n' "$archive" >&2; exit 1; }
  rm -rf "$stage"/* "$stage"/.[!.]* "$stage"/..?* 2>/dev/null || true
  tar -xf "$root/$archive" -C "$stage" --no-same-owner
  if [ -f "$stage/deletions.txt" ]; then
    while IFS= read -r removed; do
      [ -n "$removed" ] || continue
      case "$removed" in
        /*|*..*) printf 'unsafe deletion path: %s\n' "$removed" >&2; exit 1 ;;
      esac
      rm -rf "$root/recovered/$removed"
    done < "$stage/deletions.txt"
    rm -f "$stage/deletions.txt"
  fi
  cp -a "$stage"/. "$root/recovered"/
  printf 'APPLIED %s\n' "$archive"
done < "$root/chain.txt"
printf 'RECOVERY_COMPLETE\n'
